findings.issue: Missing explicit versioning for API contracts
findings.impact: Clients may break if server changes without notification
findings.recommendation: Add a semantic version header to all API responses and document deprecation policy in the spec

findings.issue: Inconsistent heartbeat and lease timing values across documents
findings.impact: Potential race conditions in reconnection logic
findings.recommendation: Standardize on a single set of timing constants (e.g., 10s heartbeat, 30s pause, 90s expiry) and reference them in all design files

findings.issue: DTO construction uses allowlist but no explicit schema validation
findings.impact: Untrusted input could bypass field filtering
findings.recommendation: Introduce JSON Schema or TypeScript type guards for all incoming DTOs and document the validation pipeline

findings.issue: GunDB transactions cannot enforce room capacity
findings.impact: Race conditions may allow more than two players in a room
findings.recommendation: Add a server‑side capacity check before committing a new seat and reject excess join attempts with a clear error code

findings.issue: Touching ships are allowed but not explicitly documented in rules
findings.recommendation: Clarify in the rule set that ships may touch but not overlap, and provide visual feedback during placement

findings.issue: Frame‑time hysteresis is mentioned but no quantitative target is specified
findings.impact: Performance may degrade on low‑end devices without guidance
findings.recommendation: Define a target frame time (e.g., <16ms for 60fps) and include a fallback path for devices that cannot meet it

findings.issue: Chat message limit is 240 Unicode code points but no mention of emoji surrogate pairs
findings.impact: Users may exceed the limit unintentionally when using emojis
findings.recommendation: Count grapheme clusters instead of code points for the chat limit
